units.source_text: 春宵苦短，不久已近黎明。

en.t: The spring night was painfully short, and before long dawn was already near.

units.source_text: 但闻值夜的近卫武官高声唱道：“奉旨巡夜！”

en.t: Then they heard the night-duty guardsman of the Imperial Guard call out loudly, "Night patrol by imperial order!"

units.source_text: 源氏大将想道：“想必另有一近卫武官躲在这里幽会，

en.t: General Genji thought, "Surely some other guardsman has hidden here for a secret tryst,

units.source_text: 他的朋辈妒恨他，告诉了这值夜武官，

en.t: and one of his companions, jealous and resentful, told this night-duty officer,
and had him come to frighten the man."

units.source_text: 他想起自己也是个近卫大将，觉得好笑，但又觉得讨厌。

en.t: Remembering that he himself was also a general of the Imperial Guard, he found it funny, but also unpleasant.

units.source_text: 这值夜武官来来去去巡视了一会，

en.t: The night-duty guardsman went back and forth on patrol for a while,
then called out loudly again, "First quarter of the Hour of the Tiger!"
